help.profile.email: Shown on the website and used by every email link and button.
help.profile.eyebrow: Short capitalised line shown above the homepage headline.
help.projects.*.slug: Identifies this project's page. It cannot be changed here.
help.projects.*.role: Shown under the contribution heading on the project page.
help.projects.*.strength: Short line shown on the project card.
help.projects.*.collaborators: Credit everyone who shared the work.
help.projects.*.galleries: Edit captions and image descriptions only; the image files are fixed.
help.projects.*.videos: Edit titles and captions only; the video files are fixed.
help.projects.*.contribution: Optional. Hidden on the website when empty.
help.projects.*.result: Optional. Hidden on the website when empty.
help.projects.*.decisionNotes: Optional. Hidden on the website when empty.
help.projects.*.validationNotes: Optional. Hidden on the website when empty.
help.projects.*.measuredOutcome: Only a measurement you can support with evidence. Leave empty otherwise; the website then hides this part.
help.projects.*.referenceUrl: Optional public link starting with https://, for example the project's source code. Leave empty if there is none.
help.recommendations.entries: Public: everything saved here becomes public in the GitHub repository and its history as soon as you save, even while "Approved" is "no". Enter a recommendation only after its author has agreed to its publication. A card is shown on the website only when it is approved and its text, name and professional status are complete.
help.recommendations.entries.*.quote: Public in the repository as soon as you save, even before approval.
help.recommendations.entries.*.name: Public in the repository as soon as you save, even before approval.
help.recommendations.entries.*.approved: Choose "yes" only after the author has agreed to publication.
help.recommendations.entries.*.url: Optional public link starting with https://.
help.academic.profiles: Only profiles with a public https:// address are shown on the website. Anything saved here is public in the repository.
help.academic.references: Public: everything saved here, including email addresses, becomes public in the GitHub repository and its history as soon as you save, even while "Approved" is "no". Add a referee only with their permission. A reference is shown on the website only when it is approved and its name, position and relationship are complete.
help.academic.references.*.email: Optional. Public in the repository as soon as you save, even before approval.
help.academic.references.*.url: Optional public link starting with https://.
help.academic.references.*.approved: Choose "yes" only after the referee has agreed to be listed.
help.currentWork.researchDetails: Shown on the Research page only when both the research question and the contribution are filled in. Anything saved here is public in the repository immediately, even while it is hidden on the website.
help.currentWork.researchDetails.artifactUrl: Optional public link starting with https://.
